name: BHARATBENZ GLIDER Z+ BS6 Luxury Coach
shortDescription: Official BharatBenz Glider Z+ BS6 Oneness luxury bus mod for Bus Simulator Indonesia with realistic engine sounds and animated doors.
description: Experience the superior engineering of the BharatBenz Glider Z+ BS6 Luxury Tourist Coach in Bus Simulator Indonesia. Features realistic BharatBenz heavy diesel engine sounds, working air suspension, full 3-button animations (passenger doors, luggage compartment, driver cabin window), custom LED lighting, Oneness liveries, and high-speed gearing for national highway cruising.
author: VayZenXPlayz
features: Authentic BharatBenz BS6 diesel engine sound loops
HD 4K interior passenger cabin with reading lamps
Realistic air brake hiss & reverse warning alarm
High-speed highway gear ratio & smooth air ride
requirements: Bus Simulator Indonesia version 4.0.4 or higher installed
40MB free storage space for mod & livery files

installationGuide.title: Download the Mod File
installationGuide.instruction: Click the Download button below to unlock and download your BharatBenz Glider Z+ mod file.

installationGuide.title: Move to BUSSID/Mods Directory
installationGuide.instruction: Open ZArchiver or your file manager, locate the downloaded file, and move it to: Internal Storage > BUSSID > Mods.

installationGuide.title: Activate in BUSSID Garage
installationGuide.instruction: Launch Bus Simulator Indonesia, open Garage (Garasi), navigate to the BharatBenz Glider Z+ coach and tap 'Use' (Pakai)!
